sloka: तौ तम् आश्रमम् आसाद्य द्रुमैः बहुभिः आवृतम् ।सु रम्यम् अभिवीक्षन्तौ शबरीम् अभ्युपेयतुः ॥३-७४-५॥
transliteration: tau tam āśramam āsādya drumaiḥ bahubhiḥ āvṛtam ।su ramyam abhivīkṣantau śabarīm abhyupeyatuḥ ॥3-74-5॥

translations.english: Both reached the beautiful hermitage full of many kinds of trees. There they saw Sabari, and went towards her.
